description: W5 'night2' path for AlphaEvolve Repository Problem 64 (3D moving sofa, snaky corridor): a mixed-fidelity CMA-ES refinement (232 generations; 7,424 coarse-grid + 1,856 fine-grid evaluations) of the w5_night1 path, in which each generation's top-8 candidates are re-scored on a 2x finer carve grid and those ranks drive recombination - aligning selection pressure with structure that survives grid refinement. Pose format identical to best_path_found in experiments/the_3d_moving_sofa: rows [x, y, z, yaw, pitch, roll], degrees, R = Rotation.from_euler('zyx', [yaw, pitch, roll], degrees=True), world = R @ body + t, body block [-4,0]x[0,1]x[0,1]. Certified with the repository's unmodified generate_sofa_and_evaluate_path at tols (0.005, 0.05 deg): 1.8339829 at grid 0.002.
zero_rotation_dither_disclosure: None needed: this path has no exact pure-translation steps (minimum per-step rotation 1.9208e-3 deg; 0 zero-rotation steps and 0 float32-degenerate substeps after the pipeline tolerance smoothing, verified in-notebook at both tolerance pairs).
